text: {"lessons":["I should not sell Stock D solely to lock in a gain; I’ll weigh its prospects and portfolio role against the cost of reducing a potentially valuable position.","Buying Stocks C and E before the account fell reminded me that good decisions can still have short-term losses; I’ll size purchases carefully and avoid reacting to one month’s return.","Because losses feel especially painful to me, I’ll use consistent, forward-looking rules for holding or selling rather than letting regret about a loss—or satisfaction from a gain—drive the decision."]}
